title: Suite
idea: Closest to the suite: each patch shows what the treatment asks of its beat and the poem line under it.

title: Scenes
idea: Each poem line plays as one continuous passage from a single archive film, shot after shot in that film's order.

title: Cineosis
idea: Each patch is chosen for the cineosis signs the suite assigns its beat, seen through the poem line.

title: Drift
idea: A dérive through the chapter's moods: every shot is chosen to follow the one before it.

title: Cels
idea: The film redrawn as cartoon cels: each poem carved into patches on her reading, each patch one moving shot redrawn in the angular multiplane style.

title: Spine-Cut Cels
idea: Spine-Cut’s reviewed picks redrawn as cartoon cels: every spine section plays the archive shot its editor chose for the line, drawn every 3 s from the drawing before, EbSynth between.
